Now I have the results. Let me also check the shelf audits to understand on-shelf availability better.

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_audits FROM store.shelf_audits sa JOIN store.products p ON sa.of_product = p.sku WHERE p.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND sa.audit_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' AND sa.audit_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sa.shelf_status = 'on shelf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_shelf_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sa.shelf_status = 'empty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_count FROM store.shelf_audits sa JOIN store.products p ON sa.of_product = p.sku WHERE p.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND sa.audit_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' AND sa.audit_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(w.write_off_units) AS total_write_offs, SUM(sc.adjustment_units) AS total_stock_adjustments FROM store.write_offs w FULL OUTER JOIN store.stock_counts sc ON w.of_product = sc.of_product WHERE w.of_product = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND w.record_date >= '2026-06-01' AND w.record_date < '2026-07-01' AND sc.count_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' AND sc.count_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```
